call_points.text: Retail consumption reached ₹16,587 Cr, growing 21% YoY in FY26, with Q4 consumption up 31%.
Gross debt stood at ₹5,164 Cr and net debt at ₹3,160 Cr, with net debt to EBITDA improving to 1.19x.
Trading occupancy at PMC Bangalore and PMC Pune is expected to reach ~90% in Q1FY27 on Uniqlo openings.
Thane, Coimbatore and Chandigarh are expected to complete by 2030; excavation has begun at Coimbatore.
Consolidated EBITDA margin rose to 60% in FY26 from 57%, with Q4 at 61% versus 55%.
72% of operational retail GLA has leases expiring between FY26 and FY30, a re-leasing opportunity without new capex.

operating_notes.text: ISMDPL Tranche 2 exit payment to CPP Investments is planned for FY27 with an application submitted to NCLT for capital reduction.
FY26 retail consumption ₹16,587 Cr (+21%); Q4 ₹4,261 Cr (+31%).
Office portfolio occupancy 70% at Mar-26; 2025 completions 62% leased.
Average cost of debt 7.51% at Mar-26, 226 bps over repo.
FY26 retail consumption reached ₹16,587 Cr, growing 21% YoY.
Phoenix Mills' stake in associate company Mirabel Entertainment diluted from 50.00% to 35.49% due to non-participation in a rights issue.
Jewelry and electronics occupy about 5% of trading area but contribute 28% of consumption and 7.5% of rental.
About 50% of the retail portfolio is up for lease expiry over the next three years.
Rise offices in Lower Parel are being pre-leased at ₹350-400 per sq ft on leasable area.
Truevalue Infrabuild Private Limited, a wholly owned step-down subsidiary of Phoenix Mills, had nil turnover and net worth of ₹3.70 lakh at 30 September 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,233.2 Cr (+21.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹403.35 Cr (+50.0% YoY).
FY26 results presentation: revenue ₹4,423 Cr (+16%), EBITDA ₹2,637 Cr (+22%), net profit to shareholders ₹1,224 Cr (+24%); net debt/EBITDA 1.19x.

Bhavik Gala, Managing Director, signed the company’s conclusion of the earnings conference call with analysts/institutional investors on April 28, 2026, discussing audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
Manilal Gala (Bhavik Gala) shared the audio recording of the earnings conference call on April 28, 2026, at 11:45 IST, for Q4FY2026 results.
2026-04-28: Phoenix Mills reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,423 Cr (+16% YoY) and net profit of ₹1,557 Cr (+20% YoY).
Phoenix Mills' stake in associate Mirabel Entertainment diluted from 50.00% to 35.49% following a rights issue.
On its 29 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Phoenix Mills reported revenue up 13% to ₹1,075 Cr and retail consumption up 32% to ₹4,730 Cr, and kept its mid-teens rental growth guidance for FY27 and FY28.

On 15 October 2026, Phoenix Mills' boards of SGH Realty and step-down arm Truevalue Infrabuild approved a scheme merging the nil-turnover Truevalue into SGH Realty, subject to RD/NCLT approval, with no cash or new shares.
